item.title: Sweden accuses third on Jacobs rink of cheating
item.description: CORTINA D’AMPEZZO, Italy — Canada’s Team Brad Jacobs pulled off a two-win day in Olympic curling action to remain undefeated — including a heated, profanity-laced win over the defending Olympic champions, who accused the Canadian third of cheating. The Canadians took down Sweden’s Team Niklas Edin 8-6 in a game that threatened to boil over […]
